🐕 Board & Train
Your dog stays with us for an immersive training program where we can work on obedience, manners, leash skills, confidence, reactivity, off-leash reliability and more.

🐾 Day Training / Day Camp
Need help with training but don’t necessarily need a full Board & Train? Your dog can spend the day working with us while still coming home to you.

🦮 Private 1-on-1 Lessons
Want to learn alongside your dog? Private lessons allow us to work directly with you and build a training plan around the issues you’re experiencing at home and in the real world.

🐶 Turnkey Puppy Program
Want to enjoy having a puppy without feeling completely overwhelmed by raising one? Our Turnkey Puppy Program gives puppies an extensive foundation during some of their most important developmental months.

We work with everything from puppies who need a great start to adult dogs struggling with obedience, confidence, manners, reactivity, and more.

📍 Serving Western Colorado and clients who travel to us from across the country.

LIVE AT SOVEREIGN ROOTS: VETERAN HEALING BEYOND THE CLINIC 📍🔥

When military service ends, the sudden loss of team, structure, and mission can leave a quiet, dangerous void.

To round out our focus during Suicide Awareness Month, Dr. Ray and Jean are broadcasting live on-location from Sovereign Roots: Veterans Retreat right here in Delta! We're sitting down with Executive Director Corey Roberts to talk about how nature, community, and hands-on work are helping local veterans reconnect and choose life.

Today at 12:15 PM, we're breaking down:
🔥 The "Rally Point" Philosophy: Why peer connection around a campfire often reaches people where clinical offices can't.
🌲 Healing on the Land: How outdoor work, fieldcraft, and nature help regulate a hyper-vigilant nervous system.
🤝 Rebuilding Belonging: How we as a Western Slope community can better support our veterans before a crisis hits.

You don't need to be broken to belong, and you don't have to face the transition alone.

Tune in LIVE to see the incredible work happening right in our own backyard!

🏡 UNDER CONTRACT IN LESS THAN THREE WEEKS

13569 3100 Road, Hotchkiss, Colorado

Sometimes a property doesn’t need another price reduction. It needs a different strategy.

This property had been on the market with another brokerage for more than 440 days. The seller was understandably frustrated and had been told, once again, that lowering the price might be the answer.

When Lovemore Real Estate took over, we took a different approach.

Instead of simply reducing the price, we looked at the property through a buyer’s eyes. We gave it some TLC, addressed minor items, brought in staging, and focused on presenting the property in a way that helped buyers see its potential.

And here’s the part we love:

We actually raised the price.

Then we went to work.

The response was immediate. We had a tremendous amount of interest, multiple buyers showing serious interest, and now this property is UNDER CONTRACT in less than three weeks.

And we may even have a backup offer coming.

That is what experience, preparation, presentation and a thoughtful marketing strategy can do.

At Lovemore Real Estate, we know that a property that has been sitting doesn’t automatically mean it needs to be cheaper. Sometimes it needs to be seen differently.

We help sellers understand what their property needs, create a plan around it, and then execute that plan.

Because getting a listing sold isn’t just about putting it on the market.

It’s about knowing how to make buyers see the value.

Seeing a handler without their service dog doesn’t mean they suddenly stopped being disabled. 💚

There are so many reasons a handler may choose—or need—to leave their service dog at home.

Maybe their needs fluctuate from day to day. Maybe they have another form of support available. Maybe the environment isn’t appropriate or safe for their dog. Or maybe their service dog simply needs a well-deserved day off. 🐕‍🦺

A service dog is a tool that helps mitigate a disability, but having a disability doesn’t mean a handler must have their dog beside them every second of every day.

You’re seeing one moment, not the whole story.

No service dog ≠ no disability. 🦮🐾💚

Let’s normalize trusting disabled people to know what support they need—and when they need it.
